name: Anatole Pache
source:
Garrulous Entrepreneurial Grub ~ Age: 29

A cheerful Levasseuri street trader who, when called upon to join the fight, effectively became his trench's 'procurer'. The charlatan Pache is quick to style himself as a philanthropic 'friend of all men', circumventing the rules for his comrades' sake and relying on his craftiness and gift of the gab to evade his COs' withering contempt.

Investigating the disappearance of his straight-laced friend Pvt. Grebe, Anatole even comes to open his clandestine black market to Wesslinger trade. He always makes sure to slip Elfriede a little something extra, with a wink and a smile - but his interest may be more intense, and more professional, than he lets on...
